</section>
<section id="A4.SS1.SSS0.Px2" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">Stable evaluation (log-space).</h4>

<div id="A4.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">We compute the weights via log-softmax to avoid overflow/underflow at small <math id="A4.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\sigma" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>σ</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sigma</annotation></semantics></math>:</p>
<table id="A4.Ex12" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A4.Ex12.m1" class="ltx_math_unparsed" alttext="\log w_{i}(x;\sigma)=\ell_{i}(x;\sigma)-\log\!\sum_{j=1}^{N}\exp\!\big(\ell_{j}(x;\sigma)\big)," display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>log</mi><msub><mi>w</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>;</mo><mi>σ</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">ℓ</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>;</mo><mi>σ</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo>−</mo><mpadded style="width:1.313em;" width="1.313em"><mi>log</mi></mpadded><munderover><mo movablelimits="false">∑</mo><mrow><mi>j</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mi>N</mi></munderover><mpadded style="width:1.370em;" width="1.370em"><mi>exp</mi></mpadded><mrow><mo maxsize="1.200em" minsize="1.200em">(</mo><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">ℓ</mi><mi>j</mi></msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>;</mo><mi>σ</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mo maxsize="1.200em" minsize="1.200em">)</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\log w_{i}(x;\sigma)=\ell_{i}(x;\sigma)-\log\!\sum_{j=1}^{N}\exp\!\big(\ell_{j}(x;\sigma)\big),</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A4.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1.2" class="ltx_p">evaluating the log-normalizer with <math id="A4.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathrm{logsumexp}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>logsumexp</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathrm{logsumexp}</annotation></semantics></math> (equivalently, using
<math id="A4.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\log\softmax" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>log</mi><mo lspace="0.167em">⁡</mo><mi>softmax</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\log\softmax</annotation></semantics></math> in autodiff libraries). We then exponentiate to obtain <math id="A4.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="w_{i}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>w</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">w_{i}</annotation></semantics></math>
and form <math id="A4.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\hat{x}^{\star}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msup><mover accent="true"><mi>x</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>⋆</mo></msup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\hat{x}^{\star}</annotation></semantics></math>.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A4.SS1.SSS0.Px3" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">Fast distances.</h4>

<div id="A4.SS1.SSS0.Px3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.SS1.SSS0.Px3.p1.1" class="ltx_p">To compute <math id="A4.SS1.SSS0.Px3.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\|x-x_{i}\|_{2}^{2}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msubsup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>x</mi><mi>i</mi></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn><mn>2</mn></msubsup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\|x-x_{i}\|_{2}^{2}</annotation></semantics></math> efficiently for many <math id="A4.SS1.SSS0.Px3.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="i" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>i</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">i</annotation></semantics></math>, we use</p>
<table id="A4.Ex13" class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_table">

<tbody><tr class="ltx_equation ltx_eqn_row ltx_align_baseline">
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padleft"></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_align_center"><math id="A4.Ex13.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\|x-x_{i}\|_{2}^{2}=\|x\|_{2}^{2}+\|x_{i}\|_{2}^{2}-2x^{\top}x_{i}," display="block" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msubsup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>x</mi><mi>i</mi></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn><mn>2</mn></msubsup><mo>=</mo><mrow><mrow><msubsup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn><mn>2</mn></msubsup><mo>+</mo><msubsup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><msub><mi>x</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn><mn>2</mn></msubsup></mrow><mo>−</mo><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mo>⊤</mo></msup><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mi>x</mi><mi>i</mi></msub></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>,</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\|x-x_{i}\|_{2}^{2}=\|x\|_{2}^{2}+\|x_{i}\|_{2}^{2}-2x^{\top}x_{i},</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A4.SS1.SSS0.Px3.p1.2" class="ltx_p">precomputing <math id="A4.SS1.SSS0.Px3.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\{\|x_{i}\|_{2}^{2}\}_{i=1}^{N}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msubsup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">{</mo><msubsup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo><msub><mi>x</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">‖</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn><mn>2</mn></msubsup><mo stretchy="false">}</mo></mrow><mrow><mi>i</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mi>N</mi></msubsup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\{\|x_{i}\|_{2}^{2}\}_{i=1}^{N}</annotation></semantics></math> once and reusing matrix products for the
cross terms.</p>
</div>
</section>
</section>
</section>
